category.quote: A minimum assured pension of ₹3,000/- per month is provided to the subscriber after attaining the age of 60 years.

age.quote: The applicant must have an entry age between 18 and 40 years.

income_band.quote: The applicant must have a monthly income of ₹15,000/- or less.

gate_notes: Must not be an income tax payer
Must not be engaged in the organized sector or hold membership in EPFO, NPS, ESIC or NPS-Traders scheme
Must possess a Savings Bank Account or Jan Dhan account number with an Indian Financial System Code
